name: MeaslesVaccinationContact
title: Measles vaccination contact
description: The data a measles vaccination contact (MEASLES.A) and its reporting (MEASLES.B) record: the core data elements MEASLES.DE.01-26.

element.definition: The data a measles vaccination contact (MEASLES.A) and its reporting (MEASLES.B) record: the core data elements MEASLES.DE.01-26.
Unique identifier of the client in the register or EIR (MEASLES.DE.01; used by MEASLES.A; rests on catchup.confirm-by-written-record)
Client's date of birth (MEASLES.DE.02; used by DT.01 DT.03 (age); rests on T1 measles footnote (ages throughout))
Client's sex (MEASLES.DE.03; used by IND.01 IND.02 disaggregation; rests on JRF 4A. Routine Coverage)
Name of the caregiver who brings a child (MEASLES.DE.04; used by MEASLES.A; rests on catchup.multi-dose-return-date)
Whether a home-based record was presented at this contact (MEASLES.DE.05; used by MEASLES.A A1; rests on catchup.confirm-by-written-record)

Whether the national schedule gives MCV1 at 9 months (high transmission) or 12 months (low transmission) (MEASLES.DE.06; used by DT.01 transmissionSetting; rests on measles.mcv1-9-months-high-transmission; measles.mcv1-12-months-low-transmission)

The infant is in a situation the measles footnote lists for a dose from 6 months (MEASLES.DE.07; used by DT.01 supplementaryIndication; rests on measles.mcv0-situations; measles.hiv-high-incidence-mcv0-6-months)
Date a measles-containing vaccine dose was given (MEASLES.DE.08; used by DT.03 DT.01; rests on measles.mcv0-recording)
How the dose counts (MEASLES.DE.09; used by DT.03 countsAs; rests on measles.mcv0-recording; catchup.mcv2-only-after-mcv1)
Which measles-containing vaccine was given (MEASLES.DE.10; used by IND.01 IND.02; rests on JRF 2A. Schedule rows 2270-2310; measles.same-formulation-both-doses)
Whether the dose is documented in a home-based record or register (MEASLES.DE.11; used by DT.03 documented; rests on catchup.confirm-by-written-record; catchup.unconfirmed-assume-unvaccinated)

element.short: Anaphylaxis or severe allergy to a vaccine component
element.definition: History of anaphylaxis or severe allergic reaction to any component (e.g. neomycin or gelatin) (MEASLES.DE.12; used by DT.02; rests on measles.contraindications)
Client has any form of severe immunosuppression (MEASLES.DE.13; used by DT.02; rests on measles.contraindications)
Client is pregnant (MEASLES.DE.14; used by DT.02; rests on measles.avoid-in-pregnancy)
Client has a mild concurrent infection (recorded; not a reason to defer) (MEASLES.DE.15; used by DT.02; rests on measles.mild-infection-not-contraindication)

element.short: Date of last other live vaccine
element.definition: Date another live vaccine (not OPV) was last given (MEASLES.DE.16; used by DT.02 weeksSinceOtherLiveVaccine; rests on measles.live-vaccine-spacing; catchup.live-vaccine-spacing)
Client's HIV status (MEASLES.DE.17; used by DT.01 DT.04; rests on measles.hiv-routine-vaccination; measles.hiv-exposed-mcv0)
Client is receiving highly active antiretroviral therapy (MEASLES.DE.18; used by DT.04; rests on measles.hiv-haart-additional-dose)
Date HAART was started (MEASLES.DE.19; used by DT.04 monthsSinceHaartStart; rests on measles.hiv-haart-no-cd4-monitoring)
Most recent CD4+ T lymphocyte count as a percentage (MEASLES.DE.20; used by DT.04; rests on measles.hiv-haart-additional-dose)
The additional dose after immune reconstitution has been given (MEASLES.DE.21; used by DT.04; rests on measles.hiv-haart-additional-dose)
Outcome of screening before vaccination (MEASLES.DE.22; used by MEASLES.A G2; rests on DT.02)
Why no dose was given at this contact (MEASLES.DE.23; used by MEASLES.A A9; rests on measles.avoid-in-pregnancy; measles.contraindications; measles.live-vaccine-spacing)
Date the next MCV dose is due (MEASLES.DE.24; used by MEASLES.A A7 A9; MEASLES.B B1; rests on catchup.multi-dose-return-date)
Proof or documentation of measles immunity or immunization for a health worker (MEASLES.DE.25; used by MEASLES.S4; rests on measles.health-worker-immunity)

A confirmed measles case (laboratory or epidemiological link; reported clinical cases included as the JRF instructs) (MEASLES.DE.26; used by IND.07; rests on JRF 1. Reported Cases row 1020; Instructions row 10)
